blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Test-time scaling allocates additional inference compute to refining existing solutions or generating new ones. This raises a fundamental question: Should I keep improving this solution, or stop working on it and try a completely new solution? Existing methods make this decision using fixed refinement schedules, self-verification judgments, or learned controllers, which can waste compute or rely on signals that may be incorrect or require additional training. We introduce Adaptive Replay Refinement (ARR), a training-free method that detects when a stationary revision reaches a fixed point and reallocates the released compute to a new independent sample; replay decoding treats the current solution as a draft and verifies unchanged tokens in parallel, enabling efficient fixed-point detection. Across seven models from five families and seven benchmarks, ARR matches majority voting on three of five mathematical reasoning benchmarks at equal compute, while reducing critical-path serial passes by up to 2.4 times. On MATH500, ARR achieves 84.6% accuracy with only 41% of the serial passes required by majority voting. These results demonstrate that detecting refinement exhaustion enables adaptive reallocation from revision to independent sampling, improving inference efficiency while highlighting the limits of self-revision. Code is available at https://github.com/AhsanBilal7/adaptive_refine.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models can improve reasoning performance by using more computation at inference time ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Brown et al., 2024 ) . Existing approaches primarily spend this compute in two ways: Parallel methods generate multiple independent solutions and aggregate their answers, typically through majority voting ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , while sequential methods repeatedly revise a single solution, often through separate feedback and refinement stages ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Recent approaches combine these strategies by sampling several solutions, refining them, and aggregating the resulting answers ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Snell et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型可以通过在推论时间使用更多的计算来提高推理性能(Snell等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;Brown等人,2024年). 现有方法主要用两种方式计算: 并行方法产生多种独立解决方案并汇总其答案,通常通过多数表决(Wang等人,2023年),而顺序方法反复修改单一解决方案,通常通过单独的反馈和完善阶段(Madaan等人,2023年;Shinn等人,2023年). 近期的方法将这些战略结合起来,对若干解决办法进行取样,加以改进,并汇总由此产生的答案(Chen等人,2025a); Snell等人, 2024 ).

blocks.en: Combining sampling and refinement creates a fundamental allocation problem: When should additional compute try to improve an existing solution, and when should it generate a new one? Prior work typically relies on one of three mechanisms. Fixed refinement schedules apply a predetermined number of revision rounds, which can waste compute after further refinement stops changing a solution and often require validation data to choose the schedule ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) . Self-verification methods stop when the model judges its own solution to be correct ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Samanta et al., 2026 ) , but such judgments can be unreliable without external feedback ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Stechly et al., 2024 ; Kamoi et al., 2024 ) . Learned or score-based controllers instead use trained verifiers, predicted difficulty, or confidence estimates ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) , introducing additional training, calibration, or threshold selection. These approaches also incur unnecessary sequential computation because revision commonly regenerates most of a solution even when only a small portion changes. Figure 1 shows that revision exhausts after few steps and that a fixed schedule wastes the rest of its compute.

blocks.en: We address this problem by detecting when a deterministic and stationary revision procedure can no longer change a solution. Once a revision exactly reproduces its input, further applications of the same procedure are redundant. We use this event as an exact signal that refinement of that solution has been exhausted. We introduce Adaptive Replay Refinement (ARR) , a training-free method that uses replay decoding to efficiently detect when refinement reaches a fixed point and reallocates the released compute to a new independent sample (Figure 2 ). ARR therefore adapts refinement depth and sampling breadth directly during inference, without requiring a tuned refinement depth, correctness threshold, critic, or learned controller. While draft verification, fixed-point iteration, and training-free self-refinement have each been studied previously ( Sun et al., 2021 ; Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Santilli et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) , ARR uses these components to detect exhausted refinement and redirect compute to new attempts; a fixed point signals only that further revision is redundant, not that the solution is correct. Table 8 in Appendix I compares this stop signal with those of the closest methods, and also discusses sequential scaling, efficient reasoning, and fixed points in sequence models.
blocks.zh: 我们通过发现何时确定性和固定性的修订程序不能再改变解决办法来解决这一问题。 一旦修订完全复制其投入,进一步应用同一程序就多余。 我们用这一事件作为确切的信号,即这一解决办法的完善已经用尽。 我们引入了适应性重放(Adaptive Replay Finement),这是一种无训练的方法,它使用重放解码来在精度达到固定点时有效检测,并将释放的计算重新分配给一个新的独立样本(图2). 因此,ARR在推论中直接调整精细深度和取样宽度,而不需要调制精细深度,正确性阈值,批判性,或学习型控制器. 核查、定点迭代和无训练自精草案在以前都进行过研究(Sun等人,2021年;Leviathan等人,2023年;Santilli等人,2023年;Madaan等人,2023年),但ARR使用这些组件来检测疲劳的精度,并将计算重定向到新的尝试中;固定点信号只是进一步修订是多余的,而不是解决方案是正确的。 附录中的表8 我将这个停止信号与最接近方法的信号进行比较,还讨论顺序缩放,高效推理,以及序列模型中的固定点.

blocks.en: Contributions. First, we formulate iterative refinement as an adaptive allocation problem between improving existing solutions and generating new ones, and introduce a training-free rule that reallocates compute once refinement is exhausted. Second, we establish that replay decoding preserves the output of ordinary greedy revision , making exact reproduction a valid fixed-point stopping signal. Third, we introduce a compute-matched evaluation protocol that accounts for all processed computation and includes controlled variants that isolate the effect of each component. Fourth, across seven models from five model families and seven benchmarks, ARR matches majority voting on three of five mathematical reasoning benchmarks at equal compute while shortening the serial critical path by up to 2.4 \mathbf{2.4} times ; our analysis also identifies two settings in which the underlying revision procedure itself is ineffective.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 首先,我们制定迭代完善办法,作为改进现有解决办法和产生新解决办法之间的适应性分配问题,并引入一项无培训规则,一旦完善办法用尽,即可重新分配计算。 其次,我们确定重播解码会保留普通贪婪修正的输出,使精确复制成为有效的固定点停止信号. 第三,我们采用一个计算匹配的评价协议,记录所有经过处理的计算,并包括隔离每个组件效果的控制变体。 第四,在5个模范家庭和7个基准的7个模型中,ARR与对5个数学推理基准中的3个进行多数表决的相等,同时将序列关键路径缩短最多2.4\mathbf{2.4}次;我们的分析还确定了基本修订程序本身无效的两个环境。

blocks.en: Design choices. Replay verifies only a contiguous draft prefix, since tokens beyond the first mismatch are conditioned on an invalid prefix. Unlike aggressive and prompt lookup decoding, which may realign after mismatches ( Sun et al., 2021 ; Saxena, 2023 ) (Section 4.1 ), replay switches immediately to standard greedy decoding, preserving exact equivalence to F x F_{x} while incurring at most one failed block per revision. Thus, replay verifies the existing solution against a new revision, and when the entire draft is accepted without changes, ARR detects a fixed point and reallocates compute to a new sample.

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks with exact-answer scoring: MATH500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) (500 problems), AIME (30 problems per edition), AMC (40 problems), and the 674 English text-only competition mathematics problems from OlympiadBench ( He et al., 2024 ) . We include GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) (1,319 problems) as a saturated control and evaluate generalization beyond mathematics on LiveBench reasoning tasks ( White et al., 2025 ) , comprising web of lies, zebra puzzles, and spatial reasoning (50 problems each). Appendix B details answer extraction and scoring.

blocks.en: Compared methods. We select baselines spanning independent sampling, fixed-depth and stochastic revision, explicit self-verification, and confidence-based allocation, alongside controlled ARR variants that isolate decoding and root replacement. All methods use the same FLOP accounting, T max T_{\max} , and answer extractor ϕ \phi ; root-based methods additionally share N = 4 N{=}4 initial roots and majority aggregation, while ConMA retains its group-based selection procedure (Table 1 , Appendix D ). Majority Voting ( Wang et al., 2023 ) spends the entire budget on independent samples from σ ⁡ ( x ) \sigma(x) , providing a pure-sampling baseline for evaluating the benefit of revision. ARR AR and ARR PLD retain ARR’s allocation rule but compute F x F_{x} with autoregressive greedy decoding and prompt lookup decoding ( Saxena, 2023 ) , respectively, isolating the effect of replay from the underlying allocation policy; their single revisions are equivalent to ARR’s under Section 3.2 , while full runs can differ because of decoding cost and scheduling (Appendix D ). ARR Depth removes root replacement from Equation ( 4 ) to isolate the effect of reallocating exhausted depth to breadth, while Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) applies F x F_{x} for a fixed D = 4 D{=}4 revisions, providing an iteration-limited baseline for assessing redundant refinement. SETS ( Chen et al., 2025a ) replaces F x F_{x} with a two-stage critique-and-correction update, F x vc F_{x}^{\mathrm{vc}} , while keeping ARR’s replacement rule, isolating the effect of explicit self-verification on revision quality. Sequential Revision ( Snell et al., 2024 ) repeatedly samples a non-stationary continuation from ρ cont ​ ( x , y r ( k ) , k ) \rho_{\mathrm{cont}}(x,y_{r}^{(k)},k) until the budget is exhausted, contrasting stochastic, depth-dependent revision with ARR’s deterministic stationary operator. ConMA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) is a confidence-based controller: it samples groups of trajectories, keeps the kernel of answers with the highest token-level confidence, and re-samples or asks a multiple-choice question until one answer remains, providing an adaptive alternative based on confidence rather than exact fixed-point detection (Appendix D ). We fix N = 4 N{=}4 for root-based methods and W = 32 W{=}32 for ARR’s replay decoder across models without tuning; replay exactness (Section 3.2 ) ensures that W W affects decoding speed but not revision output.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
ARR gives more accuracy for each serial pass. Figure 3 shows accuracy against the median number of serial passes on the critical path. This number sets the latency of a question.
On MATH500, AMC23, and AIME24, the curve of ARR is above the curves of ARR AR , SETS, and Majority Voting for most of the range.
For example, ARR gets the best accuracy of Majority Voting on MATH500 (84.6%) with only 41% of the serial passes of Majority Voting.
On OlympiadBench, the curves of ARR and Majority Voting are almost the same, and on AIME25 and GSM8K, Majority Voting is better.
blocks.zh:
ARR为每张连环传球提供了更高的准确度. 图3显示的是关键路径上连续通过次数的中位数。 此数定一问因缘.
在MATH500,AMC23和AIME24上,ARR的曲线高于ARR AR,SETS,以及大多数范围内的多数投票的曲线.
例如,ARR在MATH500(84.6%)上获得多数投票的最佳准确度,只有41%的连续多数投票证。
在奥林匹亚德本奇,ARR和多数投票的曲线几乎相同,在AIME25和GSM8K上,多数投票更好.

blocks.en:
At equal FLOPs, ARR matches majority voting on three of five math benchmarks. At the largest budget, ARR and Majority Voting have the same accuracy within noise on MATH500, AMC23, and AIME24 (Figure 6 , Appendix H ).
On OlympiadBench and AIME25, Majority Voting is better by up to 7.3 points.
The cause is the number of votes. Majority Voting spends all of the budget on independent samples, but ARR also spends compute on revisions and thus collects approximately six times fewer votes (Table 5 ).
More votes help most when revision repairs few answers (Section 4.3 ).
All other methods that revise get lower accuracy, and ARR Depth and Self-Refine also spend fewer FLOPs (Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh:
在同等的FLOP中,ARR与对五个数学基准中的三个进行多数投票一致. 在最大的预算中,ARR和多数投票在MATH500、AMC23和AIME24(图6,附录H)的噪音中具有同样的准确性。
在奥林匹亚奔驰和AIME25,多数 投票最多可达7.3分。
原因是票数。 多数 投票将预算全部用于独立抽样,但ARR也用于计算修改,因此所得票数大约为6倍(表5)。
更多选票在修改时帮助最大(第4.3节)。
所有其他修改方法都获得较低的准确度,ARR深度和自读也花费较少的FLOP(图7 ).

blocks.en:
ARR and majority voting give different trade-offs. Each slot of Majority Voting samples its votes in sequence, so its critical path is long.
At equal FLOPs, ARR needs only 41-61% of the serial passes of Majority Voting.
On one A100 GPU and a MATH500 subset, ARR answers a question in a median of 78.5 s, and Majority Voting answers it in 176.5 s with the same accuracy (Table 7 , Appendix H ).
At equal latency, the result changes: with a limit of 8,000 serial passes on MATH500, the two methods get the same accuracy, but Majority Voting uses less than half of the FLOPs (Figure 17 ).
Thus, ARR is more efficient in latency at a fixed FLOP budget, and Majority Voting is more efficient in FLOPs at a fixed latency.

发展成果评估和多数表决有不同的取舍。 多数投票的每一个时间段都按顺序抽取其选票,因此其关键路径很长.
在同等的FLOP,ARR只需要41-61%的连续多数投票通行证.
在一个A100 GPU和一个MATH500子集上,ARR以78.5s的中位数回答一个问题,多数投票以相同的准确度回答176.5s(表7,附录H).
在等长时,结果变化:在MATH500上限制8000个串行通行证,两种方法获得相同的准确度,但多数投票使用FLOP不到一半(图17).
因此,在固定的FLOP预算中,ARR在延迟性方面效率更高,在固定延迟性方面,多数投票在FLOP中效率更高.

blocks.en:
Replay makes revision faster without a change in output. Replay gives the same revisions as ARR AR and decreases the critical path by up to 30%.
This decrease becomes larger with the budget, because deeper roots reproduce longer prefixes (Figure 8 ).
Because replay verifies reused text in parallel, ARR also writes fewer tokens than Majority Voting: on MATH500, it writes approximately 40% of the output tokens of Majority Voting for the same accuracy.
blocks.zh:
重播使得修订速度更快,产出没有变化. 重播给出了与ARR AR相同的修订,将关键路径减少高达30%.
随着预算的增加,这种下降会变得更大,因为更深的根部会复制较长的前缀(图8 )。
因为重播验证了重复使用的文字,ARR也写得比多数投票少:在MATH500上,它写了大约40%的多数投票输出符号,以同样准确.

blocks.en: A confidence controller saves compute but loses accuracy. ConMA stops generating samples once only one answer remains under consideration, reducing inference cost through early stopping. Across completed settings, it uses approximately half of the compute budget and requires half as many serial passes as ARR (Figure 7 ). However, this efficiency comes at the cost of accuracy: at B = 800 B{=}800 , ConMA performs 1.2-9.5 percentage points worse than ARR (Figure 6 ). This suggests that confidence-based stopping can save compute but may terminate sampling too early, potentially missing better answers.
blocks.zh: 置信控制器会保存计算但失去准确性. CONMA一旦只考虑一个答案,就停止产生样品,通过及早停止降低推论成本。 在整个已完成的设置中,它使用大约一半的计算预算,并需要与ARR(图7)一样多的连续通行证。 然而,这种效率是以准确性为代价的:在B = 800 B = 800 B = 800时,ConMA的成绩比ARR(图6)差1.2-9.5个百分点。 这表明基于信心的停止可以节省计算,但可能过早终止采样,可能缺失更好的答案。

blocks.en: 4.3 When Revision Should Receive Compute
blocks.zh: 4.3 修订时应接受计算

blocks.en:
Revision provides early gains but quickly saturates. Revision improves root accuracy by 0.5-2.4 points, but 49% of the first revisions of ARR (over all roots, including new ones) reach a fixed point, and answer changes become rare after four revisions (Figure 4 ).
By reallocating compute from converged roots to new samples, ARR reaches 84.6% accuracy, matching Majority Voting and outperforming ARR Depth (81.5%; Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh:
修订提供早期增益,但快速饱和. 修订提高根精度0.5-2.4点,但ARR的首次修订(在所有根,包括新根)有49%达到固定点,4次修订后答案变化变得罕见(图4).
通过将计算从汇合根重新分配给新的样本,ARR达到了84.6%的准确度,匹配了多数投票和业绩优于ARR深度(81.5%;图4)。

blocks.en: The fixed point is an exact signal, not necessarily the most accurate stop. ARR’s condition F x ​ ( y ) = y F_{x}(y)=y guarantees that further deterministic revisions leave the solution unchanged, without requiring answer extraction, thresholds, or correctness labels. We compare two simpler rules with the same root replacement: (i) answer stability, which stops when ϕ ⁡ ( F x ​ ( y ) ) = ϕ ⁡ ( y ) \phi(F_{x}(y))=\phi(y) , and (ii) one-revision stopping, which retires a root after a single revision. At B = 800 B{=}800 , answer stability outperforms ARR by 4.0 points on AIME25 (95% CI [ − 2.0 , + 10.7 ] [-2.0,+10.7] ) and 2.2 on OlympiadBench ( [ + 0.3 , + 4.2 ] [+0.3,+4.2] ), while both stopping rules remain within 1 point on MATH500 and GSM8K (Figure 5 (b), Table 2 ). These rules retire roots before their solutions converge, generating 1.8-2.4 times more roots but requiring 1.09-1.29 times more serial passes (Figure 5 (c)). Thus, fixed-point stopping gives the shortest critical path among the tested rules, although earlier stopping can sometimes improve accuracy.

ARR的条件F x (y) = y F_{x}(y) =y 保证进一步的确定性修改使溶液保持不变,而不需要解答提取,阈值或正确性标签. 我们比较两个较简单的规则和同一个根替换: (一)回答稳定性,当QQ(F x (y))=QQ(y)\phi(F_{x}(y))\phi(y)\(y)\(y)\(y)\(y)\(y)\(y)\(y)\(y)\(y)\(fx)\(y)\(y)\(fx)\(i)\(i)\(e)\(i)\(e)\(fx)\(fx)\(i)\(e)\(fx)\(fx)\(fx)\(i)\(f)\(f)\(fx)\(x)\(x)\(x)\(x)\(x)\(x)\(i)\(x)\(x))\(x(x))\(x(x))\(x(x)))\(x(x))\(x(x)))\(x(x)) B = 800 B = 800 B = 800,回答稳定性在AIME25(95% CI [−2.0,+10.7] [-2.0,+10.7])和奥林匹亚奔驰([+0.3,+4.2] [+0.3,+4.2])的回答比ARR高出4.0分,而停止规则在MATH500和GSM8K(图5(b),表2)均保持在1分以内。 这些规则在溶液汇合之前就不再使用根,产生1.8-2.4倍的根,但需要1.09-1.29倍的连环通行证(图5(c))。 因此,固定点停止在经过测试的规则中提供了最短的关键路径,尽管较早停止有时可以提高准确性.

blocks.en: The net repair of F x F_{x} decides between revision and sampling. Over different model-benchmark settings, the net repair of F x F_{x} predicts the accuracy difference between ARR and Majority Voting (Pearson r = 0.76 r{=}0.76 , Figure 5 (a)). With a net repair above 0.25%, ARR is 1.3 points better than Majority Voting on average; with a negative net repair, Majority Voting is 8.7 points better, most of all on LiveBench and with Qwen3.5-2B (Section 4.6 ). Revision should thus receive compute only when it repairs more answers than it breaks, and this condition explains both the successes and the failures of ARR. In two Gemma-4 settings, ARR is 7.0-14.5 points better for a reason other than reasoning: 37-41% of the samples end with a boxed answer, against 98-100% after revision.
4.4 Component Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 构成部分分析

blocks.en:
The exchange of depth for breadth is the source of the gain. ARR Depth keeps the fixed-point test but does not replace retired roots.
Thus, it stops when its four roots get to fixed points, and it uses less than half of the budget on MATH500.
ARR gives this released compute to new roots and is 3.1 points more accurate on MATH500 and 4.0 points more accurate on OlympiadBench.
Figure 10 shows the two sources of gain separately. Revision of the initial roots adds at most 2.5 points.
The new roots add 3.0-6.0 points, and this gain increases with the budget. The same order holds for all models.
blocks.zh:
深度交换宽度是收益的来源. ARR深度保持固定点测试,但不会取代退役根.
因此,当它的四根根到达固定点时就停止了,它使用不到预算的一半的MATH500.
ARR给这个释放的计算给新的根,在MATH500上是3.1分更准确,在Olympiad Bench上是4.0分更准确.
图10分别显示两个收益来源。 对初始根的修订最多增加了2.5点。
新根加3.0-6.0分,这一增益随预算而增加. 所有型号都一样

blocks.en: A greedy and stationary revision operator works best. We compare two revision alternatives (Table 1 ) across FLOP budgets (Figure 6 ). SETS adds an explicit critique step, reducing MATH500 accuracy by 1.5 points while remaining within noise on other benchmarks. Despite reaching more fixed points (69% vs. 23%), it repairs fewer answers (Table 5 ). Sequential Revision replaces greedy revision with sampled continuation, causing MATH500 accuracy to drop from 79.3% to 59.0% as the budget increases, 25.6 points below ARR at B = 800 B{=}800 (Figure 6 (a)). It also breaks more correct answers than it repairs (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 一个贪婪的固定式审校操作员最有效. 我们比较了《油污损害赔偿法》预算中的两个修订备选方案(表1)。 SETS增加了一个明确的批评步骤,将MATH500的准确度降低了1.5分,同时保持在其他基准上的噪音. 尽管达到了更多的固定点(69%对23%),但它修复的答案较少(表5)。 序列修订以抽样延续取代贪婪的修订,使得MATH500精度从79.3%降至59.0%,比预算增加时的ARR低25.6点,B=800 B{=}800(图6(a))。 它还打破了比修复更正确的答案(表5)。

blocks.en: The allocation rule does not depend on replay. ARR PLD uses the same rule with prompt lookup decoding. It gets similar accuracy with approximately 55% of the serial passes of ARR. The cause is the first change in a revision. On average, a revision reproduces only 26-35% of its input before this change. After this point, replay decodes one token at a time, but prompt lookup can align to the draft again. Thus, a decoder with realignment makes ARR faster, and the fixed-point signal stays the same. In wall-clock time, ARR PLD needs 54% of the latency of ARR (Table 7 , Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 分配规则不依赖于重播. ARR PLD 使用同样的规则,并带有即时检索解码. 它的精度与ARR系列通行证的约55%相似. 病因是修订中的第一个变化. 平均来说,一次修订只复制了本次修改前其投入的26-35%. 这一点之后,一次重放一个符号解码,但即时查询可以再次与草稿对齐. 因此,有调整的解码器使ARR更快,固定点信号保持不变. 在墙上时间,ARR PLD需要占ARR延迟的54%(表7,附录H)。

blocks.en: ARR is robust to its settings. A larger width helps: with N = 8 N{=}8 , ARR gains 1.9 points over N = 4 N{=}4 and needs fewer serial passes. The block size W W changes the serial passes by at most 5%, and two paraphrases of ρ \rho change the accuracy by at most 1.2 points. Appendix H gives all ablations and the detailed values of this section.
blocks.zh: ARR对它的设置很强健. 宽度较大的帮助:用N=8 N{=}8,ARR比N=4 N{=}4增加1.9分,需要更少的连环通行证. 块大小 W W 最多以 5% 更改序列通过, 并且 $\rho 的两个参数在 1.2 点 更改精度 。 附 录 H给出了本节的所有缩写和详细值.

blocks.en: 4.5 Generality across Models
blocks.zh: 4.5 各种模型的通用性

blocks.en:
The results transfer to four more model families. Figure 9 shows the five other models at their largest budget, over different settings. Three trends of the primary model also hold for these models.
First, the exchange of depth for breadth helps: ARR is better than ARR Depth and Self-Refine in most of the settings, by approximately 6 points on average.
Second, the decoder does not change accuracy: ARR, ARR AR , and ARR PLD are within 0.4 points.
Third, ARR and Majority Voting are close, and Majority Voting is 1.5 points better on average.
This difference decreases to 0.7 points when we remove Qwen3.5-2B, where revision breaks answers (Section 4.6 ), and two Gemma-4 settings, where revision only repairs the answer format.
blocks.zh:
结果转移到另外四个模范家庭。 图9显示其他五种模式在不同情况下的预算最大。 主要模式的三种趋势也支持这些模式。
首先,深度交换有助于: 在大多数设置中,ARR优于ARR深度和self-Refine,平均约6点.
第二,解码器不会改变准确性:ARR,ARR AR,和ARR PLD在0.4点以内.
第三,ARR和多数 投票接近,多数投票平均得1.5分。
此差值在删除 Quen3.5-2B 时降至 0. 7 点, 其中 修订 解答 (第 4. 6 节) , 以及 两个 Gemma-4 设置, 其中 修订只修复 解答格式 。

blocks.en: 4.6 Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 4.6 失败模式

blocks.en: A fixed point shows that revision is exhausted, not that the solution is correct. Thus, ARR is weak when revision breaks more answers than it repairs. On LiveBench, Majority Voting is better for all five models, by up to 20.4 points (Figures 9 (f) and 5 (a)). With Qwen3.5-2B, revisions are very short and often give only a final answer, and ARR is 15-24 points below Majority Voting on MATH500 and AMC23 (Figure 9 (a,c)). The accuracy of ARR is therefore limited by the quality of its revision operator.
blocks.zh: 一个固定点表明修正已经用尽,而不是解决方案是正确的. 因此,当修订破解的答案多于修复时,ARR是薄弱的。 在Live Bench上,多数投票对所有五个模式来说都更好,最高得20.4分(图9(f)和5(a))。 使用Quen3.5-2B后,修改时间很短,往往只给出最后答案,ARR比MATH500和AMC23的多数投票低15-24分(图9(a,c))。 因此,ARR的准确性受到修订操作员质量的限制.

blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: 5.1 Parallel Test-Time Scaling and Sample Aggregation
blocks.zh: 5.1 平行试验时间缩放和抽样汇总

blocks.en:
Trained verifiers can rank candidate solutions ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2023 ) , whereas self-consistency samples multiple chain-of-thought solutions and returns the most frequent answer ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
Adaptive-Consistency ( Aggarwal et al., 2023 ) and ESC ( Li et al., 2024 ) terminate sampling once answer agreement is sufficiently strong. Snell et al. (2024) allocate inference compute between sampling and revision using a learned verifier and predicted problem difficulty, and solution coverage generally increases as more samples are generated ( Brown et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
DeepConf ( Fu et al., 2025 ) and ConMA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) instead use token-level confidence signals to filter or expand candidate groups.
blocks.zh:
训练有素的核查人员可以对候选人的解决方案进行排序 (Cobbe等人,2021年;Lightman等人,2023年),而自相容性则对多个思维链的解决方案进行样本,并返回最频繁的答案(Wang等人,2023年).
适应性-一致性(Aggarwal等人,2023年)和ESC(Li等人,2024年)一旦答案一致足够强,就终止采样。 Snell 等人著. (2024年) 利用已学会的核查器和预测的问题难度在取样和修正之间分配推论计算,随着生成更多的样本,溶液的覆盖范围一般会增加(Brown等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年)。
DeepConf(Fu等人,2025年)和ConMA(Wang等人,2026年)转而使用象征级信任信号过滤或扩展候选组别.

blocks.en: 5.2 Self-Refinement and Self-Correction
blocks.zh: 5.2 自理和自理

blocks.en:
Welleck et al. (2022) train a separate corrector that iteratively revises the outputs of a generator.
Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) retains verbal feedback across trials, while Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) alternates self-generated feedback with iterative revision.
Self-Debug ( Chen et al., 2023b ) and CRITIC ( Gou et al., 2024 ) incorporate execution feedback or external tools.
Without such feedback, intrinsic self-correction often fails to improve reasoning and planning performance ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Stechly et al., 2024 ; Kamoi et al., 2024 ) .
Other approaches train multi-turn self-correction directly through supervised or reinforcement learning ( Qu et al., 2024 ; Kumar et al., 2024 ) .
SETS ( Chen et al., 2025a ) repeatedly verifies and corrects sampled solutions until receiving a “correct” verdict before aggregation, whereas Thought-ICS ( Samanta et al., 2026 ) identifies the first erroneous reasoning step and resamples from the preceding prefix.
blocks.zh:
Welleck等人(2022年)培训一个单独的校正器,迭代修改一个生成器的输出.
Reflexion(Shinn et al., 2023)保留了跨审判的口头反馈,而Self-Refine(Madaan et al., 2023)则通过迭代修订自行生成反馈.
自我调试(Chen等人,2023b)和CRITIC(Gou等人,2024)包含执行反馈或外部工具.
没有这种反馈,内在的自我纠正往往无法改善推理和规划业绩(Huang等人,2024年;Stechly等人,2024年;Kamoi等人,2024年)。
其他方法通过监督或强化学习直接进行多回合自我矫正(Qu等人,2024年;Kumar等人,2024年)。
SETS(Chen等人,2025a)反复核实和纠正抽样解决办法,直至在汇总前收到“正确”判决,而思科中心(Samanta等人,2026年)则从前句中确定了第一个错误的推理步骤和复标。

blocks.en: 5.3 Draft-and-Verify Decoding
blocks.zh: 5.3 起草和核实解码

blocks.en:
Aggressive decoding ( Sun et al., 2021 ) verifies spans copied from the input in parallel.
Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them with the target model in parallel ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023a ) .
LLMA ( Yang et al., 2023 ) reuses spans from a reference sequence, while prompt lookup decoding ( Saxena, 2023 ) and PLD+ ( Somasundaram et al., 2025 ) retrieve candidate continuations directly from the prompt.
blocks.zh:
主动解码(Sun等人,2021年)验证从输入中平行复制的跨度.
光谱解码通过起草多个代币并用目标模型并行验证来加速自动生成(Leviathan等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年a).
LLMA(Yang等人,2023年)从一个参考序列开始重复使用,同时迅速进行检索解码(Saxena,2023年)和PLD+ (Somasundaram等人,2025年)直接从即时检索候选续作.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: ARR reframes test-time scaling as an online allocation problem between improving an existing trajectory and exploring a new one. Our results suggest that allocation does not require predicting correctness directly; detecting when refinement stops being useful can be enough to redirect compute to new attempts. This perspective opens several directions, including stronger or task-adaptive revision operators, decoders that realign after edits, integration with verifiers and reasoning models, and richer signals for deciding when to revise, resample, or terminate. More generally, progress-aware allocation could enable inference systems to allocate compute based on the marginal utility of continued reasoning, prioritizing useful reasoning over fixed schedules.
blocks.zh: ARR将测试时间缩放作为改进现有轨迹和探索新轨迹之间的在线分配问题。 我们的结果表明,分配并不要求直接预测正确性;在改进停止后发现有用,就足以将计算结果转用于新的尝试。 这种视角打开了多个方向,包括更强或任务适应性修订操作器,编辑后重新调整的解码器,与验证器和推理模型的整合,以及更丰富的信号,用于决定何时修改,重新模拟,或终止. 更一般地说,了解进度的分配可以使推断系统能够根据持续推理的边际效用来分配计算,将有用的推理放在固定时间表之上。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: ARR requires access to model logits and the decoding loop, limiting its use with text-only APIs or hidden-reasoning systems. A fixed point indicates only that deterministic refinement is exhausted, not that the solution is correct, so ARR relies on independent replacement roots and aggregation. Finally, ARR prioritizes lower serial latency over matched-FLOP accuracy; its weaker regimes on LiveBench and Qwen3.5-2B motivate evaluating stronger revision operators and larger reasoning models.
blocks.zh: ARR要求访问模型日志和解码环路,限制其使用只有文本的API或隐藏理由系统. 一个定点只表示决定性完善已经用尽,而不是解决方案是正确的,所以ARR依赖于独立的替换根和集合. 最后,ARR将更低的序列延迟时间放在比对的FLOP精度之上;它在Live Bench和Quen3.5-2B上的较弱制度促使评价更强的审校操作员和更大的推理模型.

blocks.en:
Why exact variants differ in accuracy. The exactness of replay (Section 3.2 ) concerns a single revision, whereas a full run under a shared FLOP budget can diverge for three reasons. (i) Cost. The accounting charges every verified draft position, including rejected ones (Section 3.4 ), so the same revision costs a different number of FLOPs under each decoder, and the budget ends at a different point. (ii) Scheduling. The decoders finish revisions at different speeds, so the concurrent roots of a question consume the budget in a different order.
This changes the reserve for calls in progress, which root receives the last affordable new sample, and which revision the budget truncates; the variants therefore create different numbers of roots (16.2, 15.9, and 13.3 per MATH500 question at B = 800 B{=}800 , Table 5 ). (iii) Numerics. One near-tie broken differently by a batched and a serial pass flips a token and changes the rest of the trajectory of that root, including whether it reaches a fixed point.
Accuracy differences among the three variants therefore reflect these run-level effects, which are largest on benchmarks with 30-40 questions, not different revision operators.
blocks.zh:
为什么准确的变体在准确性上有所不同. 重播的准确性(第3.2节)涉及一次修订,而根据共同的FLOP预算进行的全程可以有三种原因。 (一) 费用。 每一个经核实的汇票都收取会计费用,包括被拒绝的汇票(第3.4节),因此,同样的修订费用在每个解码器下要花费不同的FLOP,而预算则在不同的时间结束。 (二) 时间安排。 解码器以不同的速度完成修改,所以一个问题的并行根源会以不同的顺序消耗预算.
这改变了在建呼叫准备金,该准备金收到最后一份负担得起的新样本,并修订了预算截断;因此,这些变数产生不同的根数(16.2、15.9和13.3/MATH500问题,B=800 B{=}800,表5)。 一个近端因批次不同而断裂,一个串行传翻转一个符号,并改变根的其余轨迹,包括它是否达到固定点.
因此,三个变体之间的准确性差异反映了这些运行级效应,这些效应在30-40个问题的基准上最大,而不是不同的修订操作员.

blocks.en: ConMA. We implement ConMA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) with the hyperparameters of the paper (8 trajectories per round, weights 0.3 and 0.7 for the full-sequence and tail confidence, a tail of 128 tokens, a consensus weight of 0.5, a kernel threshold of 0.75, and an expansion trigger of 0.5) and its verbatim prompts. A trajectory gets a confidence score from the geometric mean of its token probabilities over the full sequence and over its tail; answer groups are ranked by consensus and mean score, and the kernel is the smallest set of top groups with a cumulative probability of at least the kernel threshold. If the kernel is large, ConMA samples new trajectories from a critical-review prompt; otherwise it asks a multiple-choice question over the kernel. It stops when one answer remains or when the budget cannot fund another round, and it shares the FLOP accounting and the answer extractor of the other methods.

blocks.en: Key Observations • Majority Voting counts each sample once, and thus a frequent shared error wins the vote. • ARR revises each sample until the revision is stable, and thus a root with the correct result in its derivation can correct its conclusion. • Revisions 1 and 2 do not change the answer, so a fixed schedule of two revisions keeps the incorrect answer. • ARR continues because the text still changes, and it stops as soon as the text stops changing.

blocks.en: I.2 Sequential scaling and efficient reasoning.
blocks.zh: 一.2 顺序规模和高效推理。

blocks.en:
Long reasoning traces frequently spend tokens on redundant reflection ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , including those of reasoning models trained with reinforcement learning ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) .
Budget forcing extends or ends a reasoning trace to control its length ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) , and Sui et al. (2025) survey such efficient reasoning methods.
ARLCP ( Yu et al., 2026 ) trains models to reflect less with length-sensitive rewards.
ARR keeps the weights frozen and removes a different redundancy: the repeated generation of unchanged text across revision rounds.
blocks.zh:
漫长的推理痕迹经常用于冗余反射(Chen等人,2025年b),包括经过强化学习培训的推理模型(DeepSeek-AI,2025年).
预算强迫扩大或结束一个推理追踪来控制其长度(Muennighoff等人,2025年),以及Sui等人。 (2025)调查这种高效的推理方法.
ARLCP (Yu et al., 2026) 列车车型,在长度敏感的奖励下进行较少反射.
ARR保持了权重的冻结,并移除了不同的冗余:各修订回合重复生成未变文本.

blocks.en: I.3 Fixed points in sequence models.
blocks.zh: 一.3 序列模型中的固定点.

blocks.en:
Deep equilibrium models compute fixed points of layers ( Bai et al., 2019 ) , and Jacobi decoding iterates a parallel greedy update to its fixed point ( Santilli et al., 2023 ; Kou et al., 2024 ) .
In these methods, the fixed point is the output.
In ARR, the fixed point is a stop signal for one solution in a population of solutions.
blocks.zh:
深平衡模型计算层的固定点(Bai等人,2019年),雅各比解码了平行的贪婪更新到其固定点(Santilli等人,2023年;Kou等人,2024年).
在这些方法中,固定点是输出.
在ARR中,固定点是一组解决方案中一个解决方案的停止信号.

blocks.en: Inference servers reuse cached prefixes across requests ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , which is complementary to replay.
